subject: Q3 prep: OKR heatmap findings + narrative outline for QBR
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Q3 prep: OKR heatmap findings + narrative outline for QBR

Team —

Attached are the outputs from the quarter scoring pass: a heatmap (qbr_q3_okr_heatmap.png), the raw scores by team (team_scores_202605.csv), and an initial narrative draft (okr_narrative_draft_v1.md). High level takeaways first: 

- Overall: 64% of stretch KR targets achieved (weighted). Distribution skewed: infra/platform OKRs under-index vs. product/eng delivery.
- Top risk: Model serving reliability (Objective SRE) — several KRs missed because of unexpected regressor latency under burst.
- Biggest win: Cost per 1k tokens down 22% vs. last quarter due to batching + quantization pilot (large impact for Hosted customers).

I sketched a three-part QBR narrative in the draft: 1) Signal: what the numbers say (heatmap + colors); 2) Causation: why we saw that (root causes + experiments); 3) Forward ask: measurable commitments for next quarter (canary rollout plans, SLA targets, focused hiring).

Asks: 
- Vivek: please review the proposed objective-level narratives (section B of the draft). Note where you'd like the language softened vs. escalated — I want the exec readout to be candid but constructive.
- Laura: can you add a one-paragraph customer impact example for the Cost KR (we have a good quote from Acme that I think strengthens the win).
- Marcus: verify the scoring math in team_scores_202605.csv (I applied the new weighting matrix; want a sanity check).

Timeline: final narrative by EOD Friday (2026-05-29) so I can assemble slides Monday morning. If we need an internal dry-run, tentatively Tues 6/1 10am.

Thanks — short notes welcome.

Best,
Monica Patel
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr_q3_okr_heatmap.png (image/png), okr_narrative_draft_v1.md (text/markdown), team_scores_202605.csv (text/csv)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 prep: OKR heatmap findings + narrative outline for QBR

On Mon, May 24, 2026 at 08:13 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attached are the outputs from the quarter scoring pass...

Quick pass — thanks for pulling this together. A couple of immediate items from my side: 

1) Narrative tone: emphasize that the cost reductions were product + infra collaborative wins; call out the Optimize team by name (they owned the quant project).
2) Scoring adjustment: For the serving reliability objective, I think one of the KRs should be downweighted because it measured an internal incident window that was vendor-caused. I'll flag the KR in the CSV and leave a short comment.
3) Ask re: customer impact: happy to help draft the Acme quote if Laura is tied up.

Also — for QBR, small ask: can we include a single-page heatmap legend that maps color -> action (green: amplify, yellow: monitor, red: intervene with roadmap/people/hiring ask). I added a mock legend note in the Drive link.

Vivek
SVP Product
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-27T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 prep: OKR heatmap findings + narrative outline for QBR

On Tue, May 25, 2026 at 09:02 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick pass — thanks for pulling this together. A couple of immediate items...

Thanks — added a short Acme customer blurb to the narrative draft (section 2.c). Also made two small edits: 
- tightened the phrasing on the cost KR so it reads as a repeatable operational improvement;
- added a one-line forward ask to include cost-saving playbooks in the public docs (customer enablement angle for Console).

Marcus — I looked at the CSV and the new weighting logic looks fine, but two teams (Serving + Infra) had KRs that double-counted the same incident window. Marcus, can you reconcile?

I'll be offline Thu afternoon but can review a final pass on Friday morning.

Cheers,
Laura
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 prep: OKR heatmap findings + narrative outline for QBR

On Wed, May 27, 2026 at 11:46 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — added a short Acme customer blurb to the narrative draft...

I've reconciled the scoring issues in team_scores_202605.csv and uploaded v2 to the Drive. Two notes: 
- I removed the duplicate incident from Serving by tagging the vendor outage as a separate note rather than a KR failure. New weighted aggregate moves the SRE objective +6 points (from 48 -> 54).
- I added a confidence column (low/med/high) per KR — helpful for the narrative to call out evidence quality.

Monica — draft narrative looks good overall. One strategic suggestion for the QBR slide set: replace the full table on slide 3 with a compact heatmap + three bullets of causation per red objective (keeps the audience focus on decisions).

I'm free for a dry-run Tue 6/1 10am as Monica suggested.

Marcus
Chief of Staff, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 prep: OKR heatmap findings + narrative outline for QBR

Thanks all — consolidated updates received and applied. Summary of changes for the final QBR deck: 

- Heatmap updated (qbr_q3_okr_heatmap.png) with legend mapping -> action.
- Narrative revised: shorter causal bullets + explicit forward asks (canary plans, 2 hires for infra, 1 cross-functional cost ops PM).
- Data: team_scores_202605.csv v2 uploaded (Marcus). Confidence column included.
- Customer blurbs: Acme quote inserted (Laura).

Next steps: I'll assemble the slides Monday and post the deck link by 9am. Dry-run Tue 6/1 10am — calendar invite to follow. If anyone wants any last-line edits, send them by EOD Monday 5/31.

Thanks again — we have a crisp, decision-oriented story.

- Monica
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
